content: Tooling decision (2026-07-28): Context7 MCP is now the required way to fetch documentation for any library, framework, SDK, API, CLI, or cloud service before writing or changing code that touches it. Rationale: the project runs bleeding-edge versions (Kotlin 2.2, AGP 9, Compose BOM 2026.x) where training data is stale. Added a 'Context7 (current library documentation, required)' section to CLAUDE.md with the resolve-then-query flow and a seed id map (AndroidX /androidx/androidx; Compose /websites/developer_android_develop_ui_compose; /kotlin/kotlinx.serialization; /kotlin/kotlinx.coroutines). Others resolve on first use. Not for business logic, refactoring, or general concepts. AGENTS.md points Codex at it too.
